wind.prediction: GFS seamless previous_day1, 24h lead, city coordinate only
wind.comparison_pairing: Forecast and persistence evaluated on the same available hours; first 24h omitted from paired comparison

pm25.model: CAMS global archived series; not a fixed-lead forecast
pm25.reason: No independent quality-controlled station archive has been paired

fire.reason: No independent perimeters/arrival times or event-site fuel measurements

months: กุมภาพันธ์
pm25_catalog.limitation: Downloaded 2026 rows cover January-February only. Publisher cites GISTDA; station IDs, QA and averaging-window end times are not established. Do not label as paired PCD measurements.

limitations: FIRMS counts detections, not confirmed incidents or burned area; no detections does not prove no fire.
Peak days and dense tiles selected using hindsight. This is not a blind prospective test.
Later points within 5km/6h are candidates, not verified continuation of the same fire.
First satellite detection is a proxy origin/time; true ignition is unknown.
FM1 and 5/8/11% fuel moisture, flat slope and .1/.2/.4 midflame factors are uncalibrated assumptions.
375m is nominal VIIRS resolution, not a confidence radius. Coverage uses pixel centers without buffering.
Wind is a model-versus-reanalysis comparison at the city, not midflame or station validation.
CAMS PM2.5 is a separate model, not smoke emitted from this simulated fire.
No overall fire-spread / PM2.5 accuracy percentage can be established from these data.
